title: Which of these bills comes back every month?
concept: Capex-shaped costs are decisions you make twice a year. Opex-shaped costs are bills you pay daily. Blending them into one per-query number hides which is which.
skill: You can sort a cost line into recurring or one-off, and say which input drives each -- which is what a client actually asks.
deeper: docs/60-cheatsheets/frameworks/cost-iceberg.md -- the 69% of the bill that is not tokens
